nota: N-06: entablamento de Éolo esticado 2,0×; ampliar não cria detalhe. Peça nova em densidade nativa.

args.description: a long horizontal Greek temple entablature beam of pale marble with a bronze trimmed frieze of swirling wind spirals and flying cloud motifs, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile, a wide flat band. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the entablature. Palette of pale marble, bronze and sky blue accents. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
